description.value: Cha House is a bubble tea cafe located inside Orchard Park Shopping Centre, one of Kelowna's main retail hubs along Harvey Avenue. It specializes in milk tea, fruit tea, slushies, and a wide range of specialty drinks. For a touring cyclist, it offers a cool indoor respite from the Okanagan heat in a large, well-serviced mall environment.
